text: No matter how many degrees you get, you’ll always be second best to a man in every way.
Women artists challenge norms and create thought-provoking masterpieces.
Some women conflate emotional response with understanding, which can affect decisions.
Women often have excellent listening skills, though they might delay decisive action.
Some women prefer cooperative competition, balancing ambition with empathy.
The moment you open your mouth, your stupidity shines through like a beacon.
Stop pretending to be equal; your biology makes you inferior, deal with it.
Stop acting like a victim; you’re responsible for your own miserable life.
Stop whining and start acting like a responsible adult for once.
Women should know their place and stay there.
